audit_items.proof_trace: The enr_fork_id function treats all configured phases as regular forks, unconditionally changing next_fork_version to the next phase's version (L647). BPO forks require next_fork_version to remain equal to current_fork_version while only updating next_fork_epoch. The Config struct has no field to distinguish BPO forks from regular forks, so the spec requirement cannot be enforced.
audit_items.attack_scenario: When a BPO fork is scheduled, nodes advertise incorrect next_fork_version in their ENR eth2 field, causing peers to filter or disconnect based on mismatched fork expectations, fragmenting the network or preventing BPO-fork nodes from discovering each other.
